title: How to sum non-adjacent cells and ranges
task: One total from scattered cells — separate blocks, specific columns, odd corners.

excel.note: SUM takes up to 255 arguments — ranges and single cells mix freely.

explanation: SUM's arguments are a list — each can be a range or a lone cell, and they don't need to touch: 30 + 20 + 50 = 100 here. Ctrl+clicking cells while typing the formula builds the list for you. Watch one trap: overlapping ranges double-count (SUM(A2:A10,A5:A15) counts A5:A10 twice), and if the scattered cells share a meaning, a status column plus SUMIF usually ages better than hard-coded addresses.
